newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine inmate makes hasty snack of evidence.
newsitem.headline: Argentine inmate makes hasty snack of evidence.

text.p: An Argentine inmate was sentenced to another year in prison for ripping pages from his file in court and eating them, the state-run Telam news agency said on Friday.
Bewildered guards and court officials looked on as Marcelo Adrian Mendoza, 33, held for another crime, made a hasty snack of the documents to destroy the evidence against him.
He was sentenced to a year for obstructing justice. He had previously received an eight-year term for another unspecified crime.
